scope: Clarify existing fixed event vocabulary from actual original callback sites; no extra Source reaction, callback, listener, timer, authority read or business change.

rows.position: After original shared controller.abort(), including nested synchronous listeners.
After original finish controller.abort(); actual close transition separately observed.
After original shared factory controller.abort(); no timer/narrow/close trigger inference.
After SAME original shared child abort callback c.abort(); actual affected selected child only. Nullable private alias prevents TDZ; no root inference.
After SAME existing parent listener's clock.close() returns, including nested close/stop notes.
After SAME existing parent listener's clock.close() returns, including nested close/stop notes.
After original alive=false/clear/remove/c.abort sequence. Only child-finally here; no second invented abort-observed and no closed-transition.

excludedCombinations: close-call at pair-parent-abort, outer-parent-abort or pair-finally
abort-observed emitted from child finally in addition to child-finally
deadline/timer/race attribution from shared abort callbacks
pair-finally as an additional public lifecycle marker in this version
completeness: For joined-complete, parent-abort marker follows an already represented closed-transition of the SAME bound clock. A prefix with an explicit observation deficit may preserve uncertainty; never turn missing closure into complete. Repeated legitimate abort observations with distinct sourceSequence remain valid and do not replace firstClose/firstError.
meaning: parent-abort names the original parent-listener path only; it is not the initiating physical trigger, deadline expiry, first cause or race winner. Nested child/factory close notes may precede parent marker and OP root-abort marker. Arrival at Node does not define Source effect order.
requiredControls: Independent positives for each child role, each parent marker, repeated legitimate observations and nested ordering; negatives for wrong role/cause, fake child transition, extra close-call marker, duplicate sequence and joined-complete marker lacking prior same-clock closure. Source tests must invoke actual original seam callbacks, not models alone.
